title: az boards iteration team list [--team ${team}] --project ${project} --output json
description: The iterations a team plans in, the team forge_settings.ado.team names, else the project's default team, which az takes when --team is left out, which kit draws as the iterations stage's in `modules/bash/forge/ado.sh` (forge/ado:iterations, with `modules/jq/forge.jq` forge::ado_iterations); every call kit makes through forge/ado:az also carries --org ${organization} --detect false --only-show-errors. The extension reads TeamSettingsIteration, https://learn.microsoft.com/rest/api/azure/devops/work/iterations/list?view=azure-devops-rest-7.1. An iteration with no dates has null attributes.
